remarks: New flooring and fresh paint throughout. Updated kitchen cabinets and countertops, new bathroom vanities and light fixtures. Adorable three bedroom, two full bath ranch style home with walk up attic for unlimited storage on a beautifully landscaped corner property in a convenient location minutes to everything. Cozy living room with oversized window and built in shelving. Large dining room plus a den with sliders to patio and a terrific rear yard. City water/sewer and all landscaping included. Strong credit is an absolute must. A cozy gem completely refreshed and ready for immediate occupancy.
